result.title: VEPA: Verified Evolving Formal Policy for Lifelong LLM Agent Guardrails
result.summary: LLM agents increasingly operate over sensitive resources, such as private documents and mutable system states, which can create serious safety and security risks. Runtime guardrails should therefore make inspectable, reproducible, and deterministic allow or refuse decisions before potentially irreversible agent actions are executed. However, safety and security requirements are rarely complete before deployment, so guardrails need to keep adapting as new risks emerge. Existing adaptive guardrails learn from deployment experience, but they usually apply safety policies through LLM inference, which can lead to inconsistent decisions and ambiguous policy interpretations. Formal guardrails, on the other hand, enforce policies deterministically, but they usually rely on pre-deployment or task-specific policies and have no mechanism to adapt to newly observed risks. We introduce VEPA, a framework for the verified evolution of formal agent guardrails. VEPA represents the guardrail as a formal policy of executable symbolic rules over typed agent events. During deployment, we use an LLM guided by deployment feedback to propose policy patches that fix newly observed failures while preserving previously correct behavior. Then, a deterministic verifier only accepts policies that are structurally valid and conflict-free. Finally, an evidence-aware authority layer activates a verified rule only when it has enough supporting evidence, so uncertain updates cannot directly affect guardrail decisions. Across ASSEBench-Safety, ASSEBench-Security, and ATBench, VEPA consistently outperforms baselines while expanding the scope of deterministic formal-policy enforcement. These gains also hold under more challenging deployment conditions, including mixed streams, corrupted feedback, and longer horizons.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 VEPA：把 LLM agent 的运行时护栏表示为类型化事件上的可执行符号规则构成的形式化策略，部署中由 LLM 依反馈提出策略补丁，经确定性验证器筛出结构合法且无冲突的策略，再由证据感知授权层在证据充分时激活规则。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「候选更新—确定性验证器筛选—证据充分才激活」的两级门控，可能为 LVR 中多 latent 假设的验证筛选、视觉证据充分性判断与提交/停止时机提供可核查的方法线索；但论文本身不涉及视觉推理或 latent 状态生成。
